info.title: The documents a plugin scan writes and the scopes of its field dump

SCAN_DOCUMENTS.description: The documents a plugin scan writes, named here and owned elsewhere: the contract names them so the writers and readers cite one word, and keeps no shape of its own for them.
SCAN_DOCUMENTS.x-why: omx-clap-core and plugin-qualify write one scan document (FreeMixer/omx-contract#157).

oneOf.title: clapScanDocument
oneOf.description: The JSON document of omx-clap-scan, one entry per file with its plugins, parameters and ports. Owned by omx-clap-core, which writes it; its shape is omx-clap-core's reference.
oneOf.x-text: The JSON document omx-clap-scan writes, one entry per file with its plugins, its parameters and its ports.

oneOf.title: fieldDump
oneOf.description: The field dump of omx-clap-scan --fields: the line `# omx-clap-scan --fields 1`, the format's version, then one `<scope> TAB <field> TAB <value>` record per field a plugin states. Its scopes are SCAN_FIELD_SCOPES.
oneOf.x-text: The field dump omx-clap-scan --fields writes: a version line, then one scope, field and value record per field a plugin states.

SCAN_FIELD_SCOPES.description: The scopes of a field dump record, as written before the first TAB; an indexed scope is followed by `:<index>`. Named here, owned by their writers: omx-clap-core's scan (docs/scan.md there) and plugin-hostd's field dump (docs/formats.md there) keep the code that writes them.
